entries.english: CCLXXX. Karl IV promises not to seek the division or separation of the Diocese of Breslau. From the original in the cathedral chapter archive. In the charter Karl IV confirms the integrity of the bishopric and assures its bishop and chapter that he will not consent to its division or separation, in recognition of their loyalty and service. The remainder of the source is a lengthy Latin charter with associated editorial notes; its OCR transcription is substantially corrupted.
